'''''Microsorum scolopendria''''', [[Synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] '''''Phymatosorus scolopendria''''',<ref name=CFLW/> commonly called  '''monarch fern''', '''musk fern''', '''maile-scented fern''', '''breadfruit fern''',  or '''wart fern''' is a species of [[fern]]<ref>{{cite web |title=Maile-Scented Fern |website=Na mea kanu o Kamehameha |url=http://kms.kapalama.ksbe.edu/projects/2003/plants/lauaefern/ |access-date=19 September 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Microsorum scolopendria |website=National Tropical Botanical Garden |url=http://ntbg.org/plants/plant_details.php?plantid=8853 |access-date=19 September 2015}}</ref> within the family [[Polypodiaceae]]. This fern grows in the wild in the Western Pacific rim from Australia to New Caledonia to Fiji and throughout the South Pacific to French Polynesia.

The scientific name ''M. scolopendria'' has been misapplied to ''[[Microsorum grossum]]'' (and their synonyms in ''Phymatosorus'').<ref>{{cite web |title=Phymatosorus grossus – Musk Fern |website=Hawaiian Plants and Tropical Flowers |url=http://wildlifeofhawaii.com/flowers/861/phymatosorus-grossus-musk-fern/ |access-date=19 September 2015}}</ref>
